item.title: St. Mary’s names Kelly Savell as 2025–26 Teacher of the Year

item.title: PODCAST: Violent Crime in Natchitoches
item.description: Join Marvin for a candid conversation about violent crime in the City of Natchitoches. This discussion highlights a growing concern in our community and urges residents, leaders, and stakeholders to come together in search of solutions. Brought to you by Lance Lopez with Farm Bureau, Harrington Law Firm and the Sharpco Hotel Group. Paid Content

item.description: Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s deputies and multiple units from Natchitoches Parish Fire Protection District No. 2 responded on Jan. 26 around 8: 15 pm to a barn or shed fire in the 2500 block of Louisiana Highway 479 near Goldonna. item.title: Update: Natchitoches Police identify suspect wanted for Second Degree Murder
item.description: The Natchitoches Police Department has identified Daren Vaughn (B/M, 23 y.o.a. of Natchitoches) as a suspect wanted for a homicide that took place earlier this month. item.title: SWEPCO basecamp in Natchitoches supports crews during Winter Storm restoration efforts
item.description: Southwestern Electric Power Company (SWEPCO) established a basecamp in Natchitoches as part of its response to Winter Storm Fern, providing critical support for crews working to restore power across the region.
